clusters.summary: On Tuesday, November 24, 2026, a group of armed men took approximately 30 people hostage inside an Éxito supermarket in Cartagena, Colombia. clusters.headline: Leaked Russian government data suggests over 700,000 military casualties in Ukraine war
clusters.summary: Analysis of leaked data from Russia's federal statistics agency, Rosstat, suggests that Russian military fatalities in the war against Ukraine have exceeded 700,000. Reports from outlets including Mediazona and Meduza indicate that while 490,000 deaths were confirmed by the end of September, the total rises to over 720,000 when accounting for missing personnel and reporting lags. This figure represents a significant increase from previous estimates and highlights the massive human cost of the conflict since the full-scale invasion began in 2022. The data was derived from death registrations and records processed by Russian civil registry offices.
